source_data_boundaries.source_result: Application data roots are created under the app Application Support container; no custom backend source is configured.
Photo selection is user initiated and accepted image bytes are decoded and re-encoded into canonical JPEG output without copying source metadata dictionaries.
Report, backup, and restore transfers are routed through explicit system share, file exporter, or file importer actions.
Prepared diagnostics contain app version/build, device model/OS, bounded local counters, generation time, and bounded MetricKit summary; source UI states the exclusions before explicit export.
The editable system mail composer is opened only through user action and adds the prepared diagnostic JSON only for the explicit attach choice.
Commerce source uses Apple StoreKit product and verified-transaction APIs; the checked-in StoreKit catalog belongs only to the UI-test target.
The explicit erase route clears app-owned local generations, commerce cache, diagnostics, and standard app defaults; it does not claim to cancel an Apple subscription.

non_claims: No archive or export was performed.
No TestFlight or App Store upload was performed.
No live URL, support email, title clearance, App Store record, privacy answer, credential, or signing value was invented.
The checked-in StoreKit configuration is CI-only and is not production product evidence.

store_readiness_gaps.source_note: The frozen repository plan contains a 6.3-inch 1206-by-2622 set; preparation context reports the required 6.5/6.9 set is still missing. This is not a new device-CI route.

unsupported_or_dynamic_claims.claim: The final binary contains no undeclared SDK or framework.
unsupported_or_dynamic_claims.required_evidence: Exact final archive embedded-framework and privacy-report inventory.

unsupported_or_dynamic_claims.claim: Runtime network behavior matches the source-only no-custom-network-client scan.

unsupported_or_dynamic_claims.claim: App Store privacy answers are complete.
unsupported_or_dynamic_claims.required_evidence: Owner-completed answers from exact binary and support flow.
All remaining S10.6 hard gates, final archive review, legal/live inputs and final F25 evidence. S10.5 physical verification is a non-blocking deferred follow-up; this is not a physical PASS.
